description: Use this when the user has a draft answer for a public tender and wants it checked before submission, the way an evaluator would: word limit, every part of the question answered, specific evidence, firm commitments, no unfinished placeholders or empty superlatives, and what the section type needs (mobilisation, KPIs, measurable social value). Returns checks plus the tender's scoring criteria and a 0 to 5 rubric to score it against. Do not use to write a new answer (use draft_bid_response).

question.description: The buyer's question, word for word, so Winquill can check every part is answered.

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

word_limit.description: The buyer's word limit for this answer.

name: review_bid_draft
title: Check a bid answer before submitting
